explanation: Matches erdosproblems.com/134 with Alon's positive answer. For ε, δ > 0 and large n, every triangle-free G on n vertices with maximum degree < n^{1/2-ε} extends to a triangle-free supergraph H with diameter ≤ 2 (every pair adjacent or with a common neighbour) by adding at most δn² edges. Requiring diameter ≤ 2 rather than exactly 2 is harmless, because a triangle-free graph of diameter 1 has at most 2 vertices.
